findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "revisia_projects_act" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "revisia_approve_stage" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: revisia_prisma_flow_diagram, revisia_projects, revisia_projects_act, revisia_question, revisia_question_act, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening, revisia_report, revisia_export · Private data: revisia_prisma_flow_diagram, revisia_prisma_checklist, revisia_search, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening, revisia_screening_act, revisia_fulltext, revisia_export, revisia_jobs · Public sink: revisia_prisma_checklist, revisia_projects_act, revisia_question_act, revisia_screening_act, revisia_report_act · Destructive: revisia_search, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening_act, revisia_fulltext_act, revisia_extraction_act, revisia_rob_act.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: revisia_prisma_flow_diagram, revisia_projects, revisia_projects_act, revisia_question, revisia_question_act, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening, revisia_report, revisia_export · Private data: revisia_prisma_flow_diagram, revisia_prisma_checklist, revisia_search, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening, revisia_screening_act, revisia_fulltext, revisia_export, revisia_jobs · Public sink: revisia_prisma_checklist, revisia_projects_act, revisia_question_act, revisia_screening_act, revisia_report_act · Destructive: revisia_search, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening_act, revisia_fulltext_act, revisia_extraction_act, revisia_rob_act

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
